motivation: EVENT004 high-volume shocks had larger standardized declines; test severity/state confounding before proposing alpha
historical_status: All data known/adaptive; no causal identification, fresh OOS or strategy qualification
treated: All high-volume shocks retained in immutable BTC-EVENT-004 events.json
shock_control: Normal-volume shocks retained in same frozen event set
ordinary_control: Completed4H negative return in [-1.5,-0.5) prior30 sigma, normal volume ratio[.75,1.5), chronological first eligible event with72h cooldown, same prior8week seasonal volume normalization
features: Prior30 four-hour return sample sigma excluding event; standardized current shock; prior180 four-hour log return excluding event normalized by sigma*sqrt(180)

matching.distance: sum normalized absolute log sigma ratio and trend z difference; shock controls additionally standardized severity difference/.5
matching.selection: Nearest eligible preceding donor; ties newest; reuse permitted and disclosed; no future returns/label availability used in matching

costs: Unchanged EVENT004 base10bps fee+5bps slip each side, stress20+10
uncertainty: Descriptive paired means/medians and reuse counts only; no iid pair significance or bootstrap claim because reused donors link distant dates
report: All four comparisons, unmatched/missing/unique donors/max reuse, feature balance and subperiods; no re-tuning or winner promotion
ordinary_interpretation: Market-state reference, explicitly not severity matched; cannot isolate volume effect
